abstract: An outstanding challenge in molecular biology is the production of a complete and accurate set of protein interactions for a given organism. Todor et al, introduce a clever strategy to efficiently screen all protein interactions in Mycoplasma genitalium using AlphaFold3 (Todor et al, 2026).
